# Panic and Anxiety Community Support (PACS)

> A comprehensive mental health resource providing evidence-based information on anxiety and panic disorders, treatments, and self-help strategies for individuals seeking support and education.

PACS is a reliable community-driven platform dedicated to mental health education, covering multiple anxiety disorders, psychological treatments, medications, and practical self-help resources. The site serves as both an educational hub and support resource for those managing panic and anxiety-related conditions.

## Key Topics

- Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
- Panic Disorder
- Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD)
- Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Agoraphobia
- Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
- Bipolar Disorder
- ADHD
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Medication Treatment
- Anxiety Management
- Self-Help Resources
- Mental Health Support
- Panic Attacks
- Trauma Recovery

## Core Resources

- [Panic + Anxiety Community Support](https://panicandanxiety.org): Homepage providing access to reliable mental health information on anxiety and panic disorders.
- [Panic and Anxiety Disorders Directory](https://panicandanxiety.org/disorders): Comprehensive directory of panic and anxiety disorders including GAD, SAD, panic disorder, and OCD.
- [Panic and Anxiety Treatments](https://panicandanxiety.org/treatments): Main treatments hub covering medications, supplements, and talk therapy options for anxiety management.

## Anxiety and Panic Disorders

- [Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)](https://panicandanxiety.org/generalized-anxiety-disorder-gad): Comprehensive guide on GAD symptoms, causes, and treatment options.
- [Panic Disorder](https://panicandanxiety.org/panic-disorder): Detailed guide on panic disorder, panic attacks, symptoms and available treatments.
- [Social Anxiety Disorder](https://panicandanxiety.org/social-anxiety-disorder): Educational guide on Social Anxiety Disorder covering causes, symptoms and management.
- [Agoraphobia](https://panicandanxiety.org/agoraphobia): Overview of agoraphobia covering anxiety in open and crowded spaces and treatment approaches.
- [Specific Phobia](https://panicandanxiety.org/specific-phobia): Clinical guide on specific phobias covering causes, symptoms and fear management strategies.
- [Claustrophobia vs Cleithrophobia](https://panicandanxiety.org/claustrophobia-and-cleithrophobia): Comparative guide on claustrophobia and cleithrophobia phobias and treatment options.

## Related Mental Health Conditions

- [Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD)](https://panicandanxiety.org/obsessive-compulsive-disorder-ocd): Overview of OCD including obsessions, compulsions, symptoms and treatment approaches.
- [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)](https://panicandanxiety.org/disorders/post-traumatic-stress-disorder-ptsd): Educational resource on PTSD covering causes, symptoms and trauma recovery treatments.
- [Bipolar Disorder](https://panicandanxiety.org/bipolar-disorder): Educational guide on bipolar disorder covering types, mood episodes and treatment options.
- [Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)](https://panicandanxiety.org/attention-deficit-hyperactivity-disorder-adhd): Guide to ADHD covering overview, coping strategies and management techniques.
- [Hypochondria](https://panicandanxiety.org/hypochondria): Guide to hypochondria and health anxiety covering diagnosis and treatment options.
- [Burnout](https://panicandanxiety.org/burnout): Guide to burnout covering stress, fatigue symptoms, causes and treatment options.

## Treatment Approaches

- [Medication Treatment](https://panicandanxiety.org/treatments/medication): Archive of medication treatment guides for anxiety and panic disorders.
- [Talk Therapy](https://panicandanxiety.org/treatments/talk-therapy): Archive of talk therapy and psychological treatment resources including CBT and DBT.

## Self-Help and Wellness

- [Self Help Resources](https://panicandanxiety.org/self-help): Self-help resources for managing panic and anxiety including coping strategies and practical techniques.
- [Natural Supplements](https://panicandanxiety.org/self-help/natural-supplements): Archive of natural supplement guides for anxiety and panic management.
- [Exercise and Fitness](https://panicandanxiety.org/self-help/exercise): Archive of fitness and exercise guides for anxiety management and overall wellness.
